title: feat(why22): t(16,0,0)=22 via detour that leaves B16 at (16,-1,0)
science: Same wall-artifact mechanism as #6771, one radius up: exhibits the lex-first shortest nu-walk to (16,0,0) on B_18(0) (cost 22) and shows it leaves B_16 at (16,-1,0), |v|_1=17, before its single support-drop. Explicitly contrasts a displayed B_16-staying walk costing 24, so the 24 -> 22 drop is attributed to the extra corridor site rather than to any change of rule. Third instance of the pattern: nu's axis arrivals are systematically inflated by the ball wall.
verdict_pair: reverse=absent face=absent (reports t(16,0,0)=22 on B_18 vs 24 in-B_16 walk)
